verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly documents the Relay Proxy, a small Go application that runs on your own infrastructure, connects to the LaunchDarkly streaming API and proxies that connection to clients. A community engineer confirms the open-source Relay lets you run proxies closer to your services, and an edge Cloudflare SDK is also documented. missing for 10: explicit evidence that flags keep serving while LaunchDarkly is unreachable (persistent store or offline mode), explicit documentation that all SDK traffic stays inside the private network, and hands-on reports of relay resilience during vendor outages.
